response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

assumptions.assumption: 'Pass a cutoff' means Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804 (not >=).
Division is done in floating point (not integer division), per-track ratio averaged within each media type; NULL Bytes are excluded by the filter and AVG ignores NULL ratios.
Grouping is by media type (MediaTypeId and Name); each media type has a distinct name.
